title: 93 domains self-hosting authoritative DNS inside sanctioned Aeza
summary: A Certificate-Transparency-derived sweep found 93 distinct domains running their own authoritative nameservers inside the OFAC-sanctioned bulletproof host Aeza (AS210644 / AS216246, both verified currently Aeza) — proxy/tunnel, VPN, delivery-phishing and generic-scam themes co-located on the sanctioned operator's DNS, a takedown-resistance pattern.
detail: Cross-referencing newly-observed CT domains against Aeza's currently-announced prefixes (live holder verified as Aeza Group LLC) surfaced 93 registered domains whose ns1/ns2 resolve into Aeza space. Recurrent themes: anonymity/proxy infrastructure (711-proxy[.]online, bonfire-tunnel.website, edge-stream-gate[.]pro, connectser.digital), phishing (delivery-evriupdate[.]live — separate finding), and short-lived scam/parking domains. Self-hosting DNS on a sanctioned bulletproof operator rather than a mainstream DNS provider is a deliberate resilience choice. Apparent matches on other formerly-sanctioned providers (Zservers, FUNNULL, most of Media Land) were EXCLUDED after verifying their ASNs are now held by successor/commodity operators (VDSINA, CTG Server, Regxa) — only Aeza's own ASNs remain Aeza.
